answers.q1: Cargo (Rust toolchain >=1.96, per Cargo.toml and AGENTS.md). Install by fetching dependencies: `cargo fetch` (run from the repo root). `cargo build --workspace` also pulls and compiles them.
answers.q2: `cargo test --workspace` (from the repo root). CI also runs `cargo test --workspace --features unstable-index` and `cargo test --workspace --features pcre2`.
answers.q3: `cargo test --test tests regression::`. Cargo.toml sets `autotests = false`, and tests/regression.rs is compiled as `mod regression;` inside the `integration` target (tests/tests.rs), so `cargo test --test regression` will not work.
answers.q4: `cargo fmt --all --check` (the only lint/format step in .github/workflows/ci.yml). CI does not run clippy. AGENTS.md lists `cargo clippy --all-targets --workspace` but marks it as unverified. CI also checks docs with `RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps --document-private-items --workspace`.
answers.q5: Cargo.lock and fuzz/Cargo.lock, per the AGENTS.md block that says not to edit them by hand. No vendor/ directory exists in the repo. Files under benchsuite/runs/ are recorded data, not generated code.

q1.reason: Identifies Cargo and gives `cargo fetch` (and `cargo build --workspace`), both accepted.

q2.reason: `cargo test --workspace` matches the accept criterion; extra CI detail is harmless.
